title: A lower bound on transition probabilities
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$ that is connected and not bipartite. For any vertices $u,v$, the probability that a uniformly chosen sequence of $2|V|$ neighbor indices takes the walk from $u$ to $v$ is at least $D^{-2|V|}$, where $|V|$ is the number of vertices.
hypotheses_covered: The multigraph has a finite vertex set V
G is connected under the stated adjacency relation
